assets.name: so101-realistic
assets.reason: The package's arm model (spec §0.2): de-tuned gripper contacts + corrected elbow limit over the Menagerie stock model.
assets.source: Hugging Face collection zk0bot/zk0-simulation-assets (model files byte-identical to v0.1.0)

assets.name: robotstudio_so101 (stock, control runs only)
assets.reason: Control configuration only: the exact arm model under which the certified T1 gated verdict (SSOT decision 27) was produced, kept so the package can reproduce that verdict on demand.
assets.source: MuJoCo Menagerie via the certified multitask work dir
assets.version: Menagerie HEAD as used by the certified multitask benchmark

notes: Every pin in the runtime, with its reason (spec §1.3). This file's SHA-256 is hashed into every eval record the package produces, so any result can be traced to the exact stack that produced it. slice1_status: 'installed' = present in the slice-1 runtime venv; 'declared' = pin recorded now, installed with the component that consumes it (train pack / USD bridge) in a later build slice — never silently treated as present.

pins.name: python
pins.reason: LeRobot 0.7.0's installed base in all certified zk0 work is Python 3.12; the runtime carries its own interpreter and borrows nothing from the system Python (spec §1.2/§1.3).

pins.name: mujoco
pins.reason: Certified Stack A physics engine (final scorecard winner, SSOT decisions 21–23); every certified sim result in the program was produced on 4.0.1.

pins.name: numpy
pins.reason: The version in the certified sim environment on the DGX Spark (BAM-tier / rung-3 venvs) that produced the certified harness results.

pins.name: lerobot
pins.reason: The version the repaired shared checkpoint (ivelin/zk0-smolvla-fl) loads under, and the version all certified sim work used (spec §1.3).

pins.name: pyav
pins.reason: PyAV 19 breaks LeRobot 0.7.0 dataset capture (desc-scenes finding, SSOT decision 26). The resolver must never pick 19.x.

pins.name: datasets
pins.reason: Pinned alongside PyAV for the same reason (SSOT decision 26): unpinned datasets/PyAV versions silently break LeRobot 0.7 dataset capture. Exact version is fixed and recorded here when the train pack is installed (build slice 2).
pins.version: pinned at train-pack build against LeRobot 0.7.0

pins.name: newton
pins.reason: Certified OpenUSD→MuJoCo bridge of Stack A (SSOT decisions 21–23); consumed by the USD asset path, not by the MJCF sim loop.

pins.name: flwr
pins.reason: Inherited from the zk0 repo's existing pin (pyproject.toml) — the framework zk0's published FL record runs on; no Flower major-version migration is part of v0.1 (spec §1.3).

pins.name: bam-servo-model
pins.reason: The certified BAM fitted-servo integration (BAM servo tier, 2026-11-16) behind the so101-realistic v0.2.0 BAM profile (ZK0_SERVO=bam).
